name: fix_rust_u32_sum_overflow
description: Fixes a total() that sums into u32 (overflows) before widening; should accumulate in u64
prompts: The function `total(values: &[u32]) -> u64` in src/lib.rs should return the sum of all values. It's broken: it computes `values.iter().copied().sum::<u32>() as u64`, which accumulates in u32 and only widens AFTER summing - so a total exceeding u32::MAX (about 4.29e9) overflows (debug builds panic, release builds silently wrap). Fix `total` to accumulate in u64 (widen each element before adding) so large sums are correct. Keep the function name and signature; the empty slice must return 0.
